content:
cari: Hey team — customer BrightLeaf requested onboarding for Ivy-7b (FP16 PyTorch weights). They need low-latency chat and embeddings, HIPAA scope, data can't leave customer VPC. Asking for scope + ETA. Attach model link: https://files.brightleaf.com/ivy7b/v1/model.pt :eyes:

devlin: Got it. What's the intended tokenization? Byte-level bpe? Any custom special tokens?

cari: They said SentencePiece, vocab size 32k. No special tokens beyond <s> </s>. Also they reported good accuracy on medical summaries in-house.

anya: I'll pick this up for quant. Do we have model architecture details (adapter layers, parallelism)? GPT-like decoder-only? Any RMSNorm vs LayerNorm?

mika: It's decoder-only, RMSNorm, rotary embeddings, has 2x chunked KV cache per layer. I'll add to model-catalog.

sam: For Dedicated capacity calc: estimate peak concurrent sessions and avg seq len?

cari: BrightLeaf expects 150 concurrent sessions, typical seq 512 tokens, peak burst up to 300.

devlin: Steps: (1) weight ingest + format check, (2) tokenizer test, (3) quick smoke on FP16 (sanity), (4) GPTQ/LLM.int8/QLoRA experiments, (5) eval suite: medical QA + rouge + embedding cos sim. Who owns each?

anya: I'll own quant experiments. Plan: start GPTQ 4-bit+nf4, try 8-bit outlier-aware path. Need to confirm weight layout; if it's fused kernels we may need conversion.

mika: I'll do step 1 & 2 — drop a conversion command once I have the file. If conversion needed, example:
```
python convert_weights.py --input model.pt --out model-ggml.bin --tokenizer spm.model
```

ops-bot: deploy job created: deploy/ingest-4212349999 queued by mika

devlin: For evals -- can someone add BrightLeaf's prompt set to the eval repo? sample size 300. Also we should run A/B vs our Redwood-verified 7B baseline.

cari: I'll get their prompt set and NDA signed today. ETA for upload EOD.

anya: Note: HIPAA constraint -> can't use hosted sandbox. We'll need Private deployment or Dedicated with VPC peering. Ops/SRE FYI.

sam: Acknowledged. I'll sketch capacity and network. For smoke we can use ephemeral Private node in staging. Need CTO approval for HIPAA infra change?

mika: small gotcha: tokenizer binary missing in package — asked BrightLeaf for `spm.model` and `tokenizer_config.json`.

cari: They've uploaded token files to secure share. Sharing link in DM.

devlin: Tentative timeline: model ingest + smoke: 2-3 business days; quant experiments + evals: 5-7 more; production-ready in 3 weeks assuming no regressions. Anyone object?

anya: Sounds right. I'll post preliminary quant perf numbers as I run.

sam: I'll reserve capacity ticket. ops-bot: reserve/dedicated request created.

ops-bot: reserve/dedicated/4212349999 created (owner: sam)

mika: I'll start the conversion job now, will post logs here.

mika: LOG: conversion started, reading model.pt (14.2GB)

mika: LOG: conversion finished, model-ggml.bin (8.9GB) md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e

anya: starting GPTQ 4-bit, using nf4 config. Running on g5.2xlarge -> will take ~4h.

devlin: Also note to add a routing fallback policy: if quantized variant has hallucination regression, auto-fallback to FP16 baseline.

cari: Good call. Add to rollout checklist.

mika: Uploaded smoke outputs: perplexity 12.4 on internal test, sample outputs attached (redacted)

anya: First GPTQ run: perplexity 12.9, latency p50 68ms token, memory 9.2GB. Will iterate.

devlin: Let's reconvene after quant results. If any regressions on medical QA >5% drop, we'll stop rollout.

cari: Thanks all — will track as ticket RD-8421. :thumbsup:
